id: title:haacked:unwedge a session after an aborted compaction

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop agent session recovery and state cleanup after warehouse compaction failure
review.reason: The supplied observations describe a localized implementation and test for clearing the `isCompacting` flag in the desktop agent's session store when warehouse compaction fails. This is a bounded, maintenance-style change: it prevents the agent from remaining in a permanently 'busy' state after a transient failure, allowing the user to resume the turn. The implementation is visible
review.uncertainty: The chunk supplied does not include the actual failure handling or cancellation implementation, only the cleanup and tests; the tier is assigned based on the observed cleanup and test, not the broader failure recovery. No adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the cancellation or failure handling, only the test. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a branch to clear the isCompacting flag when status is 'compacting_failed'. P1.F1.H1: this.d.store.updateSession(taskRunId, { isCompacting: false, });. P1.F1.H2: Adds clearing of isCompacting in a cleanup path. P1.F2.H1: Tests clearing the busy flag on failure and cancellation.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop agent session recovery after failed compaction; clearing the busy flag allows resuming the turn.
